items.title: Restore manager/admin role lookups hardcoded to false by X-Tenant-Context bypass fix (#335)
evidence: PR #335 (fix(SECURITY-CRITICAL): close X-Tenant-Context auth bypass in 6 peer routes, 52 handlers) deleted extract_tenant_context and routed every handler through RequestPrincipal — correct fail-closed fix

to prioritise closing the bypass, role branches were replaced with `false` (least privilege) pending a real membership-role lookup: faults.rs:443 and :935 set `is_manager = false` unconditionally; critical_notifications.rs gates create_notification/get_stats on `principal.is_platform()` only

comment at critical_notifications.rs:421 states the endpoints are 'unreachable until a real role lookup is wired up' — a live functional regression: org admins can no longer create critical notifications; managers lose manager-gated fault data
TODO(security) markers point at the canonical fix: membership-role pattern in routes/organizations.rs (faults.rs:33, critical_notifications.rs:55/342, vendor_portal.rs:38)
NOT a vulnerability (fail-closed is safe) — this is incomplete migration / feature regression; one signal short of the promote threshold
